claim.adversary: ROBUST within the finite native profiles, exact affected cohorts, frozen public/name-domain witnesses, no-fallback selector and resealed semantic falsifier. Not closure of all recursive descriptors or the full goal.
claim.scope: Grammar-only extent framing of typed Dynamic bodies inside Object, with separate canonical physical/raw logical callback identities. Matched stock/generated witness: six parent rows, three two-row marks plus EOF; root JSON, Array(JSON), Array(Tuple(JSON, UInt8)), Tuple(JSON, JSON), five independent sites, typed ordinary Array(Nullable(Int64)), late shared String arms and NULL/empty-child marks. Object V3 wire 4, Dynamic V3 wire 4, String0, MAP/one bucket or MAP_WITH_BUCKETS/two buckets, BASIC/COMPACT, LZ4 and plain MRK3/MRK4. Separate generated Array(JSON)/Array(UInt8) witness: eight rows/four marks, BASIC, both mark formats, native dynamicType and exact 8/2/1/0 windows. Public writer remains whole-part sorted UInt64-key.
not_claimed: Native UInt8 COMPACT qualification from a local COMPACT positive
Every admitted recursive descriptor, typed/actual arm, owner, version, bucket count or profile is native-qualified
Dynamic-owned JSON, typed-Dynamic LowCardinality/QBit extent grammar, advanced/chunked SharedData writer layouts, String1 writer or compressed marks
Arbitrary keys/partitions, incremental append, arbitrary mixed-column interleavings or Compact MV/projection composition
All-type reader/writer parity or replacement of separately qualified Wide/metadata MV/projections
Latest upstream/all versions, identical source/runtime pins, stock MRK3 capture or identical compressed frames/bytes
Granule-only local I/O, outside-window corruption locality, single preparation, allocation order, zero allocation, RSS/large-part proof or <=10% speed parity
claim.evidence_policy: Curated index to root-executed commands and dereferenced primary/raw evidence. Field presence and structural validation are not proof. CHECK, literal SELECT and selected semantic rejection are distinct signals.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: persistent recursive framing and shared Compact reader consumers
boundaries.reason: Frozen W269 public positive exposes missing typed Dynamic Array body owner; stock MRK4 exposes canonical physical versus raw logical callback names. Post-bridge legacy direct-call regression requires an explicit selector boundary.
boundaries.rollback: Revert only the atomic W270 feature; preserve the three user-owned W263 specs, original captures and frozen previous byte/native oracles.

protected_check.property: Exact protected SHA256 values unchanged; paths are excluded from the owned-path list and staging.

boundaries.authority: Scoped local implementation, disposable native test stores, exact-path atomic local commit only. No push, original-capture mutation, unrelated staging, history rewrite or full-goal complete update.

resource_guard.execution: Root-only serial compiler/native execution; unchanged guards.

laws: MergeTreeDataPartWriterCompact.cpp: per-granule fresh ISerialization state with sample structure/statistics, first PREFIX versus later PREFIX_EMPTY and position_independent_encoding=true.
SerializationArray.cpp: position-independent Array sizes are per-row UInt64 lengths, not cumulative offsets.
ISerialization callback pair zero is canonical physical identity; pair one is raw logical getter identity. Compact MRK4 roster/coordinates use physical identity.
ColumnDynamic.cpp: NULL is not SharedVariant and does not increment ordinary/shared arm counts.
Native executable and checkout are different pinned revisions; no latest/all-version inference.

design.reuse: Existing recursive logical codecs, parsed Object/Dynamic plans, role descriptors and occurrence grids; no value-serde reimplementation or public API change. Sole Compact assembler retains compression/marks/metadata/staging.
design.extent_state: Site/role occurrence counts stay distinct from root rows; count and extent arithmetic plus cumulative budgets are checked before consumption/allocation. Unknown owners remain explicit refusals.
design.read_binding: Exact structural read-layout comparison checks descriptor/profile/sites/depths/arms/structure versions/V1 caps/shared index/role membership. Statistics deliberately excluded; parsed prefix retains statistical authority. Encoder same_prepared? identity remains unchanged.
design.callback_bridge: Retain canonical physical/raw logical pairs, bijective physical roster, exact ordered finish and authenticated MRK4 provenance. Legacy take_inline_fragment_slice is raw selector; explicit internal take_physical_inline_fragment_slice is canonical physical selector without fallback.
design.budget_delta: Two existing W263 budget tests add the one charged node/edge for the empty typed-Dynamic registry, not a budget relaxation.

source_state.seal_method: Sorted relative path, NUL, per-file SHA256, newline; SHA256 of the concatenation. Production is src/**/*.cr; source/spec/script includes src/**/*.cr, spec/**/*.cr and every regular file under scripts. Documentation is outside these pools.
